The URLs are valid and match the project's official repository. Each source has a corresponding SHA-256 checksum, which are properly specified and not set to 'SKIP', indicating that the package maintainers intend to verify the integrity of the downloaded binaries.

The package follows standard AUR packaging practices: it provides a binary-only distribution (`spor-bin`), uses `!strip` (appropriate for prebuilt binaries), and includes architecture-specific sources with verified checksums. There are no signs of obfuscated URLs, unexpected network locations, or scripts that could execute arbitrary code. The sources are pinned to a specific release tag (`v0.3.2`), ensuring reproducibility. No build-time fetches or dynamic downloads are defined in this file, as expected for a `-bin` package.

While the file does not contain the PKGBUILD itself, `.SRCINFO` is typically generated from a PKGBUILD and used by AUR helpers. Based solely on this metadata, all sources are transparent, checksummed, and hosted on a trusted platform (GitHub) under the official project account. There is no evidence of tampering, backdoors, or supply-chain attacks in the provided data.
</details>
